column4: Implement docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-09-terminal-task-state-immutability.md. Add red-before-green regression for live-history quarantine, rejected-successor recovery, unrelated-chain append, append byte preservation, and rebuild cache preservation. Verify focused tests, mesh-task self-test, source/deployed parity, and isolated fixture.
